mentions.name: Sim Racing Button Box
mentions.description: A DIY button box for sim racing built with an Arduino Nano and momentary switches, undertaken as a hands-on electronics project to relearn soldering and breadboard circuit building.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to learn a new(ish) skill and am building a button box for sim racing with Arduino Nano, momentary switches, etc.
